How To React To The Regulatory Changes
The tanker market is at somewhat of a crossroads: Trade flows are changing due to rapidly growing exports from the U.S. to Asia, one of the longest trade routes in the industry. On the other hand, due to regulatory changes, owners are required to make tough choices on how to keep operating older tonnage.

children.title: 16+ Yrs Old
children.summary: It is less likely that these vessels will have scrubbers installed as the age of the vessels will make it harder to recover the investment than with younger vessels. In preparation for the implementation of IMO 2020, owners will try to have the scrubbers installed and operational by the start of 2020 as the fuel cost differential between HFO and low sulfur fuel will most likely be highest early on, while the market adjusts to the new requirements.
